shared_elements: horizontal band running the full width of the field
row of repeated units arranged along the top edge
dense row of short vertical strokes forming a fringe/comb pattern beneath a horizontal line
rectangular framed field divided into compartments by straight lines
justification: Both surfaces organise their field into stacked horizontal registers in which a row of repeated units sits above a long horizontal line hung with a dense fringe of short vertical strokes — a reasonably specific compositional echo. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a purely linear, abstract pecked outline with grid-like compartments and no recognisable creatures, while B is a bold, rounded three-dimensional relief dominated by identifiable animal and bird figures and a disc.
